name: Lambrusco Mantovano

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Lombardy DOC in the province of Mantua for semi-sparkling red and rosé wine. It is made mainly from Lambrusco Viadanese, Maestri, Marani and Salamino, with up to 15% Lambrusco di Sorbara, Grasparossa, Ancellotta and Fortana.
